name: The Red Sea EDITION
insider_take: Where avant-garde luxury meets the pristine shores of one of the world's most biodiverse seas — The Red Sea EDITION on Shura Island is Saudi Arabia's boldest statement in ultra-modern hospitality.
whats_special: Nestled within the ambitious NEOM-adjacent Red Sea Project , The Red Sea EDITION sits on Shura Island — a man-made marvel engineered within a UNESCO-recognized coral ecosystem. As part of the exclusive EDITION Hotels by Marriott collection, this property blends Ian Schrager's signature design philosophy with the raw, otherworldly beauty of the Red Sea coast. Guests enjoy direct access to some of the world's most pristine coral reefs, with over 25 islands and 90+ dive sites within close reach. The resort is powered in part by renewable energy, honoring Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 sustainability pledge.
pro_tip: Book through the Marriott STARS program for exclusive amenities including complimentary breakfast, a resort credit, and potential room upgrades — elevating an already extraordinary stay into something truly unforgettable.
dont_miss: Don't miss a sunset dhow cruise along the Red Sea coastline — the sky turns an extraordinary palette of gold and crimson over glassy, turquoise waters. And be sure to explore the underwater world with a guided dive or snorkel; the Red Sea's coral reefs are among the healthiest and most colorful on Earth , home to over 1,200 species of fish.
pros: Pristine private island location on Shura Island
World-class diving and snorkeling in untouched Red Sea waters
Ultra-luxury EDITION brand experience with sophisticated design
Exclusive access to pristine coral reefs and marine life
cons: Remote island location requires additional travel arrangements
Limited dining and entertainment options due to secluded setting
